spatial_identity_check.method: Rendered the entire 95-coordinate source polygon and rounded baseline, then overlaid all source coordinates on the full lake inset using observed labeled graticule anchors. Assessed the full outline and adjacent-lake scope, rather than assigning from a nearest point or bounding box.
observations: The western broad lobe, northwestern apex, indented north shore, concave southern shore and curved southeast arm correspond in the full-lake map. All source coordinates were included in the visual overlay.
The lake is distinct from the red drainage-basin perimeter on Figure 1. The target source polygon traces the small lake, not the catchment.
Northern 蔡几错 and 齐格错 are shown as distinct waters in the NIGLAS process map. Overflow connection is not a reason to merge their names or areas into this target.
The full source polygon has one ring and no holes. Neither the generalized map nor this examination verifies the absence of islands or an island-exact water mask.
Short shoreline segments are obscured by satellite-track marks/labels; complete map coverage does not equal unobscured boundary measurement.
Changing area and the unspecified Figure 1 shoreline date preclude treating this baseline as a surveyed present-day shoreline.
